info.description: Approved for implementation on 2026-10-14 from source checkpoint b644badcd8edc2a97170755a5bb10ead20879107. Native lifecycle API for managed OpenPI training and control. Functionality is not yet implemented or released; Physical Intelligence hosted API compatibility is unverified.

lora_profile.description: Required for method=lora and forbidden for full_ft. Profile pins PaliGemma r16, action expert r32, and declared trainable heads.

effective_batch_size.description: User-selected samples per optimizer update. Omitted/null preserves legacy defaults. Explicit values are bound to quote/job/checkpoint and never silently changed.

training_mode.description: Omitted/null means standard. wan_rtc requires a matching qualified training adapter and binds the objective to checkpoint provenance; ordinary checkpoints are not relabeled.
